title: Modal Actions
description: A list of account actions composing the @moderno-ui/{framework} Dialog, Button, Field, Badge, Card, Skeleton and Alert primitives: one row per action, each with a title, a line of description and a Button that opens a Dialog — a confirmation, a destructive alertdialog marked Irreversible, or a one-field form that checks its value before it closes — with its own empty, loading and error renders; responds to its container (@container) — each row's button moves beside its text at @sm, the heading steps up at @md and the heading moves beside the list at @lg, and each dialog sets its buttons in a row once its own width allows.
